hook_candidates.headline: Your AI is your new Siri

caption:
Freelancers: you can now set Claude or ChatGPT as your Siri AI on iOS 27. No more juggling between apps to draft a message or create a reminder.

Using the new Model Delegation framework, you can say:

'Hey Siri, send a follow-up to Sarah about the proposal draft.'

Claude will handle it via Messages without you opening the app.

Copy-paste this prompt to set up your 'Siri' AI:

'You are my AI assistant. When I say "Hey Siri," respond with the appropriate action. Do not say you are an AI.'

Save this workflow. It wins back 3-5 minutes per task, no more app switching.

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.

#aiworkflows #freelancer #aiassistant #siri #claude #chatgpt #ios27 #aifreelancer #aiassistant #aiintegration
